title: book-watch
description: What book-watch does on its own, and what goes wrong. Built by scripts/build_dashboard.py; the counts are in docs/rules/monitoring.md.

panels.title: Last daily check
panels.description: How long ago the last daily check finished. It runs at 7am New York time.

panels.title: How it went
panels.description: The last daily check's outcome: ok, throttled or failed.

panels.title: Books it couldn't check
panels.description: Books whose eBay search failed in the last daily check. Search the logs for trigger=daily outcome=failed.

panels.title: Database can be written
panels.description: Whether the last test write reached the disk. It is made at most once a minute.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Space free on the volume the database is on.

panels.title: Restarts, last day
panels.description: Each deploy restarts the app. More than a few a day without deploys means it is crashing.

panels.title: Errors, last day
panels.description: Pages answered 5xx. A 500 is a crash; search the logs for event=page status=500.

panels.title: eBay calls, last day
panels.description: Against eBay's 5,000 a day. Read from the counts, so a restart can lose a few seconds of calls.

panels.title: Open Library calls, last day
panels.description: Against the app's own limit of 500 in 24 hours, from the ledger it enforces it from.

panels.title: Emails sent, last day
panels.description: The app sends one email a morning at most.

panels.title: Daily checks
panels.description: Each run, by how it went.

panels.title: Morning email
panels.description: Skipped with reason=setup means a Resend setting is missing on Fly.

panels.title: The last run's numbers
panels.description: Books checked, failed, emailed, and AbeBooks' reads, failures and pages out of price order.

panels.title: Checks that failed
panels.description: Search the logs for event=check outcome=failed for why.

panels.title: New copies
panels.description: Copies a check had not seen before.

panels.title: Full pages
panels.description: Checks whose page came back full, so copies past it went unseen.

panels.title: AbeBooks pages out of price order
panels.description: In each daily check. Climbing morning after morning means AbeBooks no longer sorts cheapest first.

panels.title: Calls that failed or were skipped
panels.description: By service and reason. Search the logs for event=call outcome=failed for each one.
